frame.name: team local frame
frame.derivedFrom: public/boxwork/detail/scene.json ground_scale.x, the cosine of the origin latitude

extentTeamM.derivedFrom: scene.json core.size_m = 1024 projected metres centred on the origin; x times groundScaleX

imagery.pixelSizeNote: scene.json core.image_m_per_px = 0.25 projected metres; east size times groundScaleX

tileGrid.order: row 0 is north, column 0 is west; image pixel edges sit on the extent edges

imagery.note: The tiles are not duplicated here: they are the byte-identical files already in public/boxwork/detail/ortho/ (checked by sha256 against the Marswalk app).

height.order: row 0 is north, column 0 is west; samples sit on the grid corners, so the first and last sample lie on the extent edges
height.units: metres, source areoid elevation (same as public/boxwork/height.f32)
height.derivedFrom: Marswalk public/data/dem_core.bin: uint16 little-endian codes; elevation = -3897.0 + code * 0.01 m; code 65535 becomes NaN. Decoded once, not resampled. Encoding step 0.01 m.

checks.teamNodeNote: Bilinear of this grid at every 5 m node of public/boxwork/height.f32 minus that node (float32 rounding only).
checks.fiveMetreDeviationNote: Absolute difference between this 1 m grid and the bilinear 5 m team grid, at every valid 1 m sample inside the team area. The maximum is the largest disagreement found at any 1 m sample and serves as the comparison tolerance.
